name: Pairdrop
description: PairDrop is a sublime alternative to AirDrop that works on all platforms. Send images, documents or text via peer to peer connection to devices in the same local network/Wi-Fi or to paired devices.
short_desc: PairDrop is a sublime alternative to AirDrop that works on all platforms
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: RATE_LIMIT
form_fields.hint: Set to true to limit clients to 100 requests per 5 min

form_fields.label: WS_FALLBACK
form_fields.hint: Set to true to enable websocket fallback if the peer to peer WebRTC connection is not available to the client (see App Setup notes).

form_fields.label: RTC_CONFIG
form_fields.hint: Path to a json file containing custom STUN/TURN config (see App Setup notes)

form_fields.label: DEBUG_MODE
form_fields.hint: Set to true to debug the http server configuration by logging clients IP addresses used by PairDrop to STDOUT. See here for more info. Do not use in production!
